meta.title: How to Sharpen a Dull Knife
meta.description:
Inspired by my team's recent travels to Tsubame-Sanjō, I thought I would show you how I hone and sharpen my knives!

Written instructions on honing and sharpening knives can be found on my free Patreon. Sign up and join our community all about making home cooking more easy and enjoyable: https://frienji.kenjilopezalt.com/posts/how-to-sharpen-167690015

Update: In the comments, a number of folks pointed out that research exists proving that honing does, in fact, remove metal from the blade. I went back and did some reading of my own and issued a correction. Read it for free here: https://frienji.kenjilopezalt.com/posts/how-honing-fixes-168800580

Kenji Eats Japan is a summer-long series inspired by my travels through Japan in April of this year. Super Frienjis on my Patreon enjoy exclusive access to written recipes from this series. Free Frienjis can enjoy accompanying articles and watch videos ad-free. Join us: https://frienji.kenjilopezalt.com/posts/introducing-eats-162823119

Watch the full series: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLKVyj94PRGeg&si=TlmbeVSLtjM8pR1U

🍣🍡🍚🍱 🍣🍡🍚🍱

Joining my Patreon, purchasing my books and products, and subscribing to my social media channels is the best way to support my work.
